# Two splits: one on a liability account, the other on an expense account.
# `Liabilities:Credit Card USD` −100.00 against `Expenses:Supplies:USD`
# +100.00.
#
# The supplier was paid on the company card before the bill was posted.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-12 * "Paid the supplier on the card"
	guid: "dd44ee55ff6677889900aa11bb22cc33"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "ee55ff6677889900aa11bb22cc33dd44"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "ff6677889900aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
